apps.name: MARU Password Manager
apps.shortDes: Secure local password manager to store & generate passwords with End-to-End Encryption.
apps.description:
**Take complete control of your digital security with the ultimate local Password Manager!**

Are you tired of forgetting your passwords, writing them down on risky papers, or worrying about online data breaches? This application provides a smart, simple, and highly secure solution to organize your digital life. By storing everything strictly on your local device, it ensures your sensitive information remains private and protected.

With a clean, modern, and intuitive user interface, managing login credentials for multiple accounts has never been this effortless.

**Why Choose This App?**
* **100% Local Storage:** Your passwords, usernames, and private notes never leave your phone. Experience complete privacy with zero cloud data syncing.
* **End-to-End Encryption (E2EE):** All your sensitive data is encrypted directly on your device before it gets saved. Even if someone gains access to your local files, your data remains fully protected and unreadable without your master key.
* **Advanced Password Generator:** Instantly create strong, complex, and uncrackable passwords tailored to your preferred length and security needs.
* **Complete Account Management:** Effortlessly add, view, edit, search, and delete account information. Keep your social media, emails, and banking logins organized in one safe place.
* **Secure .txt File Export:** Need a manual backup or want to transfer your data? Easily export all your saved accounts into a text (.txt) file with just one click.
* **Total Data Control & Reset:** Your data belongs entirely to you. You can wipe or factory reset all saved configurations and credentials instantly whenever you need a fresh start.

Download this powerful password locker today and enjoy genuine peace of mind!
apps.privacypolicy: This app respects your privacy. All your data is stored locally on your device and is never collected, stored, or shared on any server. Internet permission is used solely to check for app updates. AutoFill permission is used only to suggest strong passwords and manage saved accounts. Storage permission is used strictly for exporting backup files on your device.

apps.name: MARU Time Since
apps.shortDes: Track past events or count down to the future instantly with live second-by-second updates!
apps.description:
Stay connected to your most important milestones with precision. Whether you are counting down to a future date or tracking the exact time passed since a past event, this app updates live down to the second.

Key Features:
* Dual-Mode Tracking: If you set a future date, it counts down automatically. If you set a past date, it counts up (elapsed time) seamlessly!
* Customizable Start Times: Pick any date and time effortlessly.
* Audio Effects: Optional ticking sounds for every second.
* Multi-Language Support: Available in English, Spanish, and many more.

Why Choose This App?
* Smart Logic: Automatically switches between counting down or counting up based on your selected date. If you set a date greater than the current time, it counts down (minusing); if it's in the past, it counts up!
* Lightweight & Fast: Clean user interface with zero lag.
* Fully Customizable: Tailor sounds, languages, and default times to fit your personal workflow.
apps.privacypolicy:
MARU TIME SINCE is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is handled when you use our mobile application.

1. Data Collection & Local Storage
We respect your privacy completely. MARU TIME SINCE does not collect, store, or share any personal information, user data, or tracking details on external servers. All the dates, times, and configurations you set within the app are stored strictly and securely locally on your device.

2. Permissions Used
The app may require certain permissions solely to function properly on your device:
* Internet Access: Used exclusively to check for application updates or new versions. No personal user data is ever transmitted through the internet.
* Audio/Sound Settings: Used locally to enable or disable the interactive second-ticking sound effects.

3. Third-Party Services
Because your data never leaves your device, we do not share, sell, or transfer your information to any third-party advertisers, analytics companies, or external services.

4. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected directly within this page.

5. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, feel free to reach out to the developer.
